query:
SELECT 'inadimplencia' as fonte, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(valor_a_receber) as valor_total
FROM accounts_receivable 
WHERE estado = 'EMITIDO' AND data_vencimento < CURDATE()
AND tipo IN ('TITULO', 'RECEITA', 'ADIANTAMENTO')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'planilha' as fonte, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(valor) as valor_total
FROM cobranca_planilha;
